body:
Adds `KK2000_reference_cloud_droplet_number_concentration` (1e6 m⁻³, i.e. 1 cm⁻³, the unit of N_d in the original fit) and `KK2000_reference_air_density` (1 kg m⁻³), so that the fractional powers of N_d and ρ in the KK2000 autoconversion and accretion rates act on dimensionless ratios:

```
A q_lcl^a (N_d / N_ref)^b (ρ / ρ_ref)^c      (autoconversion)
A (q_lcl q_rai)^a (ρ / ρ_ref)^b              (accretion)
```

With this normalization both rate coefficients `A` carry units of s⁻¹. The default of `KK2000_autoconversion_coeff_A` changes from 7.42e13 (the coefficient for N_d in m⁻³) to the published 1350; the two agree to 0.02 %, the rounding of that unit conversion.

Needed by CliMA/CloudMicrophysics.jl#814, which reads the new entries. Bumps the version to 1.3.3.
title: Add reference values for the Khairoutdinov and Kogan (2000) rates
